verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 80.2 (+1.3% in a day) and momentum is 38: prices are falling. 84s cost 900, 85s 2,500 and 86s 5,000. Rivals rewards just paid out, so fodder supply is high this morning.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-19T08:36:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 4,500 coins. Now 5,000. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 4,500 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 4 so far, averaging +10.1% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Sell Patri Guijarro 88 after its 32% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 46,000 coins. Now 48,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 31.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 13 of 20 so far, averaging +8.7% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Rivals rewards just paid out: buy SBC fodder now, not later
moves.detail: Rewards add fodder to the market on Thursday morning, which usually makes it cheapest then. Buy what your SBCs need now; selling it again costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 900 (1.08 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,000 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,100 (1.29 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,750 (1.54 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Paula Perea and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Paula Perea 75 Rare -39.3%; Adebayo Akinfenwa 86 Hall of FUT: Unleashed -37.1%; Leila Ouahabi 82 Rare -32.7%; Robert Lewandowski 85 Team of the week -32.4%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
